# Native inventory block variants

`native.tsv` is generated by `InventoryVariantOracle` from the pinned Beta
1.7.3 client. It records the real `iz` stack data, stack limit and maximum
durability, and calls the block's `a(face, stack.i())` for all six faces for
log and wool data 0..15. Header hashes pin the JAR and participating classes.
The fixture establishes face tiles; it does not establish inventory projection,
lighting, GUI rasterization, or block placement behavior. In particular stack
data is distinct from durability and a zero maximum durability does not imply a
zero variant value.

Run `python3 -m unittest tests.python.test_inventory_variant_oracle -v` to
compile and reproduce the fixture twice. Missing local JAR or Java skips the
live audit; incorrect hashes and mismatched output fail it.
